name: jowar
sowing_season: Kharif: June–July with the monsoon | Rabi: mid-September to mid-October on stored moisture (Maharashtra, Karnataka)
soil: Medium to deep black soil or loam, pH 6.0–8.0; rabi jowar needs deep soil that holds moisture

stages.name: Germination / Emergence
stages.description: Seeds sprout and seedlings come up in 4–6 days.
stages.irrigation: Kharif: sow after good monsoon rain. Rabi: sow in stored soil moisture.
stages.fertilizer: Basal: 50 kg DAP + 20 kg MOP per acre (half of this on light, rain-fed soil).
watch_for: Shoot fly — dead hearts in seedlings, worst in a late-sown crop
tips: Seed rate 3–4 kg per acre; rows 45 cm apart
Sow early in the season — late sowing invites shoot fly

stages.name: Seedling / Early Vegetative
stages.description: Leaves unfold and the stem thickens.
stages.irrigation: Kharif: rain-fed, drain extra water. Rabi irrigated: first irrigation at 30–35 days.
stages.fertilizer: Top dress 35 kg urea per acre at 30 days (irrigated crop or after good rain).
watch_for: Fall armyworm in the leaf whorl
tips: Thin plants to 12–15 cm apart at 15–20 days

stages.name: Panicle Initiation / Booting
stages.description: The ear head forms inside the stem.
stages.irrigation: Critical stage — irrigate if dry (second irrigation for rabi).
watch_for: Stem borer — holes in the stem
tips: For fall armyworm or stem borer, spray Emamectin benzoate 5 SG 0.4 g/litre into the whorl

stages.name: Heading / Flowering
stages.irrigation: Irrigate if dry — water stress at flowering gives chaffy heads.
watch_for: Midge — tiny flies on flowering heads, empty grains
tips: When the whole area flowers at the same time, midge damage is lower

stages.name: Grain Filling
stages.irrigation: A last irrigation at the milk–dough stage if needed.
watch_for: Grain mould if it rains near maturity (kharif)
tips: Harvest kharif jowar on time to avoid grain mould

stages.name: Maturity / Harvest
stages.description: Grains are hard with a black spot at the base.
watch_for: Grain mould if it rains at harvest
tips: Harvest when a black layer forms at the base of the grain
Dry the heads before threshing; store grain at 10–12% moisture

common_pests.name: Shoot fly
common_pests.symptoms: Central shoot of seedlings dries (dead heart)
common_pests.control: Timely early sowing; slightly higher seed rate; pull out dead hearts

common_pests.name: Stem borer
common_pests.symptoms: Holes in leaves and stem, dead hearts in older plants
common_pests.control: Emamectin benzoate 5 SG 0.4 g/litre into the whorl; destroy stubbles after harvest

common_pests.name: Fall armyworm
common_pests.symptoms: Ragged holes in leaves and sawdust-like droppings in the whorl
common_pests.control: Emamectin benzoate 5 SG 0.4 g/litre directed into the whorl

common_diseases.name: Grain mould
common_diseases.symptoms: Pink, black or white mould on grains when it rains at maturity
common_diseases.control: Harvest on time; mould-tolerant varieties; dry the heads quickly

common_diseases.name: Charcoal rot
common_diseases.symptoms: Stalks become soft and hollow and fall over; grey-black inside
common_diseases.control: Avoid water stress at grain filling; do not crowd plants; apply potash

common_diseases.name: Anthracnose
common_diseases.symptoms: Small red spots on leaves joining into big patches
